title: What Genetic Programming 2.0 Is
definition: Genetic Programming 2.0: evolving programs with modern compute scale.
description:
Genetic Programming 2.0 is evolving programs with modern compute scale. It sits squarely in Future Software Paradigms, the frontier where evolution engines science becomes program logistics infrastructure.

The stakes are bloat control-scale. Societies that master program hulls early will shape fitness design practice for generations; societies that wait will buy it from those who did not. That is why evolution engines programs worldwide now treat Genetic Programming 2.0 as a strategic capability, not a curiosity.

Inside this database: the concept defined precisely, today's real research landscape, the six component pieces every Genetic Programming 2.0 needs, five dated milestones, three runnable simulators, practice drills, the key organizations, and a master roadmap — each record with its own demo program.

definition: Simulates Genetic Programming 2.0 operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Genetic Programming 2.0 installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 26239 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where evolution engines monitoring, program logistics redundancy, or fitness design maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Genetic Programming 2.0 Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Genetic Programming 2.0: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Genetic Programming 2.0 — evolving programs with modern compute scale.

Phase 1 — Prove (evolution engines): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (program logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (fitness design): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (bloat control): program hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and research-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
